description: India GST combinations (Phase 2a): inclusive and exclusive prices crossed with discounts, shipping, UTGST, exports, reverse charge, composition, unregistered sellers, rate slabs and rounding boundaries.

cases.explain: Inter-state, prices include GST, with shipping: IGST is taken out of each inclusive amount; shipping follows the principal supply (the 5% saree line). L1: 2 x 236000 = 472000, taxable 449524 (IGST 5% 22476); L2: 1 x 59000 = 59000, taxable 50000 (IGST 18% 9000); shipping 11800, taxable 11238; tax lines: IGST 5% on 460762 = 23038, IGST 18% on 50000 = 9000; total = taxable 510762 + tax 32038 + round-off 0 = 542800.

Intra-state with a 10% line discount and a 5% invoice discount shared pro rata by line amount before tax. L1: 3 x 150000 less 10% = 405000, invoice discount -20250, taxable 384750 (CGST 9% 34628, SGST 9% 34628); L2: 1 x 99900 = 99900, invoice discount -4995, taxable 94905 (CGST 2.5% 2373, SGST 2.5% 2373); tax lines: CGST 9% on 384750 = 34628, SGST 9% on 384750 = 34628, CGST 2.5% on 94905 = 2373, SGST 2.5% on 94905 = 2373; total = taxable 479655 + tax 74002 + round-off 43 = 553700.

Inter-state, 7.5% invoice discount and shipping; shipping is not discounted and takes the rate of the larger line. L1: 10 x 12500 = 125000, invoice discount -9375, taxable 115625 (IGST 18% 20813); L2: 4 x 7499 = 29996, invoice discount -2250, taxable 27746 (IGST 5% 1387); shipping 25000, taxable 25000; tax lines: IGST 18% on 140625 = 25313, IGST 5% on 27746 = 1387; total = taxable 168371 + tax 26700 + round-off 29 = 195100.

Intra-state B2C, prices include GST, ₹50 off the invoice: the discount is shared across the inclusive amounts, then tax is extracted. L1: 1 x 118000 = 118000, invoice discount -4245, taxable 96403 (CGST 9% 8676, SGST 9% 8676); L2: 2 x 10500 = 21000, invoice discount -755, taxable 19281 (CGST 2.5% 482, SGST 2.5% 482); tax lines: CGST 9% on 96403 = 8676, SGST 9% on 96403 = 8676, CGST 2.5% on 19281 = 482, SGST 2.5% on 19281 = 482; total = taxable 115684 + tax 18316 + round-off 0 = 134000.

Chandigarh to Chandigarh, price includes GST: CGST 9% + UTGST 9% extracted from the inclusive price. L1: 1 x 590000 = 590000, taxable 500000 (CGST 9% 45000, UTGST 9% 45000); tax lines: CGST 9% on 500000 = 45000, UTGST 9% on 500000 = 45000; total = taxable 500000 + tax 90000 + round-off 0 = 590000.

Chandigarh intra-UT with shipping: the 5% fabric line has the largest amount, so shipping is taxed at CGST 2.5% + UTGST 2.5%. L1: 5 x 23000 = 115000, taxable 115000 (CGST 9% 10350, UTGST 9% 10350); L2: 2 x 150000 = 300000, taxable 300000 (CGST 2.5% 7500, UTGST 2.5% 7500); shipping 20000, taxable 20000; tax lines: CGST 9% on 115000 = 10350, UTGST 9% on 115000 = 10350, CGST 2.5% on 320000 = 8000, UTGST 2.5% on 320000 = 8000; total = taxable 435000 + tax 36700 + round-off 0 = 471700.

0.25% GST (rough diamonds) on a small amount: CGST and SGST 0.125% each, rounded per component. L1: 7 x 1111 = 7777, taxable 7777 (CGST 0.125% 10, SGST 0.125% 10); tax lines: CGST 0.125% on 7777 = 10, SGST 0.125% on 7777 = 10; total = taxable 7777 + tax 20 + round-off 3 = 7800.

Gold at 3% (1.5% + 1.5%) with a quantity in grams to three decimals; B2C total above ₹50,000 without a buyer address. L1: 12.345 x 612050 = 7555757, taxable 7555757 (CGST 1.5% 113336, SGST 1.5% 113336); tax lines: CGST 1.5% on 7555757 = 113336, SGST 1.5% on 7555757 = 113336; total = taxable 7555757 + tax 226672 + round-off -29 = 7782400.

Inter-state at 40%, price includes GST: IGST = 700000 × 40 / 140 exactly. L1: 100 x 7000 = 700000, taxable 500000 (IGST 40% 200000); tax lines: IGST 40% on 500000 = 200000; total = taxable 500000 + tax 200000 + round-off 0 = 700000.

Two lines with equal amounts: shipping takes the rate of the first one (5%). L1: 1 x 100000 = 100000, taxable 100000 (CGST 2.5% 2500, SGST 2.5% 2500); L2: 1 x 100000 = 100000, taxable 100000 (CGST 9% 9000, SGST 9% 9000); shipping 10000, taxable 10000; tax lines: CGST 2.5% on 110000 = 2750, SGST 2.5% on 110000 = 2750, CGST 9% on 100000 = 9000, SGST 9% on 100000 = 9000; total = taxable 210000 + tax 23500 + round-off 0 = 233500.

The principal supply is exempt milk, so shipping is exempt too; the paneer line keeps 5%, so it is still a tax invoice. L1: 100 x 5600 = 560000, taxable 560000 (no tax); L2: 2 x 9000 = 18000, taxable 18000 (CGST 2.5% 450, SGST 2.5% 450); shipping 15000, taxable 15000; tax lines: exempt 0% on 575000 = 0, CGST 2.5% on 18000 = 450, SGST 2.5% on 18000 = 450; total = taxable 593000 + tax 900 + round-off 0 = 593900.

Export under LUT with the inclusive-price flag on: IGST is 0%, so nothing is extracted and the typed price is the taxable value. L1: 40 x 5000 = 200000, taxable 200000 (IGST 0% 0); tax lines: IGST 0% on 200000 = 0; total = taxable 200000 + tax 0 + round-off 0 = 200000; home INR at 83.25: total 16650000.

Export of goods under LUT billed in USD with freight: zero-rated IGST 0% on goods and freight; totals shown in INR. L1: 300 x 450 = 135000, taxable 135000 (IGST 0% 0); shipping 4500, taxable 4500; tax lines: IGST 0% on 139500 = 0; total = taxable 139500 + tax 0 + round-off 0 = 139500; home INR at 83.10: total 11592450.

Export with IGST paid, billed in rupees: IGST 18% charged, export note, no home-currency block. L1: 1 x 850000 = 850000, taxable 850000 (IGST 18% 153000); tax lines: IGST 18% on 850000 = 153000; total = taxable 850000 + tax 153000 + round-off 0 = 1003000.

Export with IGST paid in USD with a 10% invoice discount; IGST per line, totals converted at 83.4567. Round-off is switched off on the invoice (the builder's default for foreign-currency documents, spec/documents.md). L1: 2 x 49999 = 99998, invoice discount -10000, taxable 89998 (IGST 18% 16200); L2: 1 x 12000 = 12000, invoice discount -1200, taxable 10800 (IGST 5% 540); tax lines: IGST 18% on 89998 = 16200, IGST 5% on 10800 = 540; total = taxable 100798 + tax 16740 + round-off 0 = 117538; home INR at 83.4567: total 9809334.

Reverse charge on an inter-state supply: IGST shown but not charged; the recipient pays it. L1: 1 x 250000 = 250000, taxable 250000 (IGST 18% 45000); tax lines: IGST 18% on 250000 = 45000 (not charged); total = taxable 250000 + tax 0 + round-off 0 = 250000.

Goods transport under reverse charge with an extra delivery charge: CGST and SGST on both are shown, not charged. L1: 2 x 45000 = 90000, taxable 90000 (CGST 2.5% 2250, SGST 2.5% 2250); shipping 5000, taxable 5000; tax lines: CGST 2.5% on 95000 = 2375 (not charged), SGST 2.5% on 95000 = 2375 (not charged); total = taxable 95000 + tax 0 + round-off 0 = 95000.
A composition dealer's quotation: titled Quotation, no tax, composition declaration at the top. L1: 50 x 24000 = 1200000, taxable 1200000; total = taxable 1200000 + tax 0 + round-off 0 = 1200000.

Composition dealer selling to a registered buyer with a 2-digit HSN: 4 digits are needed, so the line is flagged. L1: 10 x 5000 = 50000, taxable 50000; total = taxable 50000 + tax 0 + round-off 0 = 50000.

Seller not registered for GST: no tax on goods or shipping; plain Invoice title. L1: 12 x 15000 = 180000, taxable 180000; shipping 6000, taxable 6000; total = taxable 186000 + tax 0 + round-off 0 = 186000.

A regular dealer selling only nil-rated and exempt goods issues a Bill of Supply. L1: 25 x 4000 = 100000, taxable 100000 (no tax); L2: 10 x 5600 = 56000, taxable 56000 (no tax); tax lines: nil 0% on 100000 = 0, exempt 0% on 56000 = 0; total = taxable 156000 + tax 0 + round-off 0 = 156000.

Quantity with three decimals: 1.125 × 333.33 = 374.99625 rounds to ₹375.00 before tax. L1: 1.125 x 33333 = 37500, taxable 37500 (CGST 9% 3375, SGST 9% 3375); tax lines: CGST 9% on 37500 = 3375, SGST 9% on 37500 = 3375; total = taxable 37500 + tax 6750 + round-off 50 = 44300.

Unregistered buyer, total above ₹50,000, with name, address and state: no warning. L1: 1 x 6000000 = 6000000, taxable 6000000 (CGST 9% 540000, SGST 9% 540000); tax lines: CGST 9% on 6000000 = 540000, SGST 9% on 6000000 = 540000; total = taxable 6000000 + tax 1080000 + round-off 0 = 7080000.

Walk-in buyer with no details and a total just under ₹50,000 after round-off: no warning. L1: 1 x 4237200 = 4237200, taxable 4237200 (CGST 9% 381348, SGST 9% 381348); tax lines: CGST 9% on 4237200 = 381348, SGST 9% on 4237200 = 381348; total = taxable 4237200 + tax 762696 + round-off 4 = 4999900.

Buyer in Karnataka but the event is held in Maharashtra: place of supply set to 27 on the invoice, so IGST applies. L1: 1 x 300000 = 300000, taxable 300000 (IGST 18% 54000); tax lines: IGST 18% on 300000 = 54000; total = taxable 300000 + tax 54000 + round-off 0 = 354000.

Issued on 20 September 2025 for a supply on 23 September 2025: the 40% rate (from 22 September) is in force, no warning. L1: 1 x 400000000 = 400000000, taxable 400000000 (CGST 20% 80000000, SGST 20% 80000000); tax lines: CGST 20% on 400000000 = 80000000, SGST 20% on 400000000 = 80000000; total = taxable 400000000 + tax 160000000 + round-off 0 = 560000000.

Grand total ₹1,050.43 rounds down to ₹1,050. L1: 1 x 100041 = 100041, taxable 100041 (CGST 2.5% 2501, SGST 2.5% 2501); tax lines: CGST 2.5% on 100041 = 2501, SGST 2.5% on 100041 = 2501; total = taxable 100041 + tax 5002 + round-off -43 = 105000.
